UnusedPrivateProperty:ConvoyLiveClient.kt$ConvoyLiveClient$/** Forwards [TripTrackingService.lastFix] to [relay] for the life of the * process, not just while a convoy/circle is joined - [ConvoyRelay.sendLocation] * is a cheap no-op while nothing is connected (it throttles, then hands * off to a socket that is simply null), so there is no cost to leaving * this running versus starting/stopping it around every [join]/ * [setNotifyCircles] cycle, and doing it once here avoids needing to. * Location is handed in rather than read from a platform API by * [ConvoyRelay] itself - see its `sendLocation` doc - so this is the * one Android-side collector that closes that gap. */ private val locationForwarder: Job = scope.launch { TripTrackingService.lastFix.collect { fix -> if (fix == null) return@collect // timeMs, not elapsedRealtimeMs - Fix's own doc: elapsedRealtimeMs // is this device's uptime basis, meaningless to a peer reading it // off the wire as FriendPosition.tsMs. relay.sendLocation(fix.lat, fix.lon, fix.bearingDeg?.toDouble(), fix.speedMps * 3.6, fix.timeMs) } }
